name: sunday-powerpoints
description: copy a template for each Sunday of the month

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon --watch src --ext ts --ignore src/webapp --exec ts-node src/server.ts
scripts.docker:run: docker run --name sunday-powerpoints -p 0.0.0.0:8080:8080 -e PORT=8080 -e NODE_ENV=development -e ROOT_PATH=P:/ -v "c:/Users/NathanBaker/OneDrive/PowerPoints/Sunday PowerPoints:/input" -v "c:/Users/NathanBaker/OneDrive/PowerPoints/Sermon Videos/Sermons:/output" -v "c:/Users/NathanBaker/OneDrive/PowerPoints/songs:/songs" -d sunday-powerpoints
scripts.docker:build-n-run: npm run docker:stop && npm run docker:rm && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:run
scripts.docker:stop-n-run: npm run docker:stop && npm run docker:rm && npm run docker:run
